title: Desk bridge v0: shell
description: Hand a link to the system: open an http, https or mailto URL in its default app, or show a file in the file manager. Scoped by shell:open schemes and paths.

ShellOpenRequest.description: Open a URL in the system's default handler, or show a file in the file manager.

target.description: An absolute URL (only http, https and mailto are ever opened), or with reveal a path (~/... or absolute) to show in its folder.

reveal.description: Show the file or folder at the path target, selected in its folder in the file manager, instead of opening a URL. A path is never opened or run.

ShellOpenResult.description: Result of shell.open: the system took the URL or showed the file.
